gaps.explanation: The printed report itself does not agree (already in report_discrepancies). Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances (p4) General column Total Disbursements 192,406.34 (General government 128,678.63 + Culture and recreation 37,230.40 + Capital outlay 26,497.31); Street column 143,597.26; total 336,003.60. Combining Statement - General Fund Departments (p10-11) Total Disbursements 199,853.75 (General 128,678.63, Community Center 11,953.33, Park 13,343.58, Police and Fire 33,944.72, Library 3,030.79, Brady Days 8,902.70). The statement's Culture and recreation 37,230.40 = Community Center + Park (incl. Park capital outlay 7,504.41) + Library + Brady Days, so Park capital outlay is counted twice (also in Capital outlay 26,497.31 = 7,504.41 + 18,992.90), and Police and Fire operating 14,951.82 (33,944.72 - 18,992.90) is not on the statement. 192,406.34 - 7,504.41 + 14,951.82 = 199,853.75; schedule (199,853.75 + Street 143,597.26 = 343,451.01) above statement 336,003.60 by 7,447.41. Both are printed figures; detail matches its printed schedule, so no fix.
